critique.evidence: Measured results are demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–72 ms, LCP 308–1288 ms, TTFB 1.5–7.5 ms, and load 129–154 ms. CLS is excellent on mobile (0) and desktop (0.0011), though tablet is higher at 0.0478. Mobile and tablet frame timing stays near 16.67 ms with no long frames; desktop averages 19.31 ms with a 33.4 ms worst frame, also with no long frames. All 17 requests complete without console, page, or request failures. The main performance liability is payload size: 1.31 MB transferred, including 1.15 MB of JavaScript, for this screen load.
critique.fix: Reduce the 1.15 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting, tree-shaking, and lazy-loading charts or off-screen panels. Investigate the tablet layout shift and desktop frame cost to bring CLS closer to zero and sustained rendering nearer 16.7 ms.
